# Vocal

> Vocal is a creator-first platform for discovering, supporting, and rewarding original fiction, poetry, and creative writing through community engagement and writing challenges.

Vocal connects writers and readers through curated content hubs, author profiles, and themed challenges that celebrate diverse creative voices. The platform emphasizes community-driven discovery and provides opportunities for creators to earn recognition and rewards for their work.

## Key Topics

- Creative Writing
- Poetry
- Fiction
- Author Profiles
- Writing Challenges
- User-Generated Content
- Content Discovery
- Story Serialization
- Personal Essays
- Creator Platform
- Community Engagement
- Daily Stories
- Top Stories
- Curation

## Core Platform

- [Vocal](https://vocal.media): Vocal platform homepage for supporting, discovering and rewarding creators
- [Top Stories](https://vocal.media/top-stories): Curated top stories and daily picks across fiction, poetry, and creative writing
- [Latest Stories](https://vocal.media/latest-stories): Latest stories feed aggregating recent content across all categories
- [Explore](https://vocal.media/explore): Content discovery browser for exploring creative writing and storytelling

## Content Communities

- [Fiction](https://vocal.media/fiction): Fiction hub featuring short stories and literary fiction from platform creators
- [Poets](https://vocal.media/poets): Poetry community hub featuring contemporary poetry and poet collections
- [Chapters](https://vocal.media/chapters): Serialized fiction hub for ongoing story chapters and reader journeys
- [Communities](https://vocal.media/communities): Directory of content communities and interest-based story categories

## Challenges & Engagement

- [Challenges](https://vocal.media/challenges): Writing contests and themed challenges with prizes for creators
- [Resources](https://vocal.media/resources): Creator guides, writing tips, challenges and community updates

## Featured Authors

- [Matthew Batham](https://vocal.media/authors/matthew-batham): Author profile for horror writer Matthew Batham on Vocal platform
- [N J Delmas](https://vocal.media/authors/n-j-delmas): Author profile for dark fiction and horror writer N J Delmas
- [Jada Ferguson](https://vocal.media/authors/jada-ferguson): Author profile for poet and writer Jada Ferguson on Vocal
- [Kera Hollow](https://vocal.media/authors/kera-hollow): Author profile for freelance writer and tutor Kera Hollow

## Featured Stories

- [Turquoise Clouds in a Green Sky](https://vocal.media/fiction/turquoise-clouds-in-a-green-sky): Short fiction story by Alice Barrett with magical realism and family drama
- [Life will find a way](https://vocal.media/chapters/life-will-find-a-way): Final chapter of sci-fi horror story Manchineel by N J Delmas
- [Lovecraft Country Is One Of The Greatest Shows Of All Time](https://vocal.media/poets/lovecraft-country-is-one-of-the-greatest-shows-of-all-time): TV show review and cultural commentary on HBO's Lovecraft Country
- [When Alcohol Became too Comfortable](https://vocal.media/psyche/when-alcohol-became-too-comfortable): Personal memoir essay on addiction recovery and coping mechanisms
